items.current: Two different falls for one event. Check NSE index history for the date and the high you mean before quoting either.
items.quote: Market khul gaya. Nifty 2,500 pe aa gaya — all-time high 6,357 se 60% neeche. CNBC pe breaking news: "Lehman Brothers bankrupt." WhatsApp pe sab bol rahe hain "bech do, aur giregi." Teri ₹5L ki equity portfolio abhi ₹2.75L ki reh gayi hai. Agle 3 mahine aur gir sakti hai. Tu kya karega?

items.current: Short-term gains tax is charged only on gains; a 30% drop cannot come from that tax alone. The figure is unexplained.
items.quote: Selling equity at distress timing often coincides with market lows. ₹2L ke ₹1.4L milenge post-tax after STCG. Mental accounting loss + actual loss.
items.why: Says Rs 2 lakh becomes Rs 1.4 lakh "post-tax after STCG".

items.current: Premiums paid every year that return Rs 18 lakh after 20 years work out to about 5.3-5.8% a year (computed). Rs 50,000 a year at a steady 12% for 20 years is about Rs 36-40 lakh, not Rs 48 lakh, and 12% is not guaranteed.
items.quote: Tera relative (insurance agent) ₹50K/year LIC endowment plan recommend karta hai. "20 saal mein ₹18L milenge. Life cover bhi." Calculation karte hain: ₹50K × 20 = ₹10L invested → ₹18L return = 3% CAGR. Alternatively: ₹50K ELSS + ₹8K term plan separately.
items.why: Says Rs 50,000 a year for 20 years returning Rs 18 lakh is "3% CAGR", and that Rs 50,000 a year in ELSS at 12% becomes Rs 48 lakh.

items.current: The government has not opened new SGB tranches since early 2024; they can only be bought on the exchange, often at a premium. "Better than physical gold" is an opinion.
items.quote: SGB gives gold price appreciation + 2.5% interest annually — better than physical gold. Buying at ATH is fine if it's portfolio allocation, not speculation.
items.why: Presents Sovereign Gold Bonds as something to buy now and as better than physical gold.

items.current: At a steady 12% a year (SIP formula, instalment at the start of each month) Rs 500 a month for 30 years is about Rs 17.6 lakh; even at 15% it is about Rs 35 lakh. This is the same sum the SIP calculator on this phone does, and the website's own js/impact.js computes it the same way.
items.quote:
Reality Check ₹500 × 12 × 30 = ₹1.8 lakh invested
Final value ≈ ₹1 crore+
Waiting 5 years can cost 30–40% of final wealth.
items.why: Says Rs 500 a month for 30 years becomes "Rs 1 crore+".

items.current: It depends on the return. For a 25-year against a 30-year SIP the shortfall is about 36% at 8%, 41% at 10% and 46% at 12% a year (computed).

items.current: CPI inflation averaged about 2-3% in FY 2025-26 and general-category FD rates are mostly about 6-7%, so "FDs lose to inflation" is weaker today (and depends on tax). Check current rates.

Inflation: 6–7%

items.why: Quotes FD returns of 5-6% and inflation of 6-7%.

items.current: Studies of loss aversion often find losses weigh roughly 2 to 2.5 times as much as gains, but the size varies between studies and people.
items.quote: "Loss hurts 2x more than gain feels good."
items.why: A research finding given as an exact number.

items.current: Selling after a 10% fall is not always a permanent loss and buying more is not always wealth creation; the page's point is about reacting without thinking.
